properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Vendored jsrsasign-all-min.js bundles the CryptoJS 3DES (TripleDES) implementation; shipped in 5 copies under the toy blockchain app's resources (src/main/resources/js and out/production/classes/js). The page addTansaction.html loads this library, so the algorithms ship to every browser; the application's own calls use SHA256withRSA signing rather than 3DES, but 3DES is available to any caller of the bundle. Replaceable here by shipping a modern library build.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Vendored jsrsasign library's HMAC-MD5 support, shipped in the same 5 resource copies; available to any caller of the loaded bundle, not called by the application's own code. MD5-based MAC is cryptographically broken; replaceable by upgrading the vendored library.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Vendored jsrsasign's EC curve registry (KJUR.crypto.ECParameterDB) registers secp256k1 among its named curves; the library is loaded by the served addTansaction.html. secp256k1 ECDH/ECDSA is Shor-vulnerable; migration ML-KEM-768 / ML-DSA. The Bitcoin-themed course project conceptually targets this curve.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: CryptoJS PBKDF2 inside the vendored jsrsasign bundle defaults to 1 iteration, 128-bit keySize and SHA-1 — a dangerously weak KDF configuration shipped in the app's resources. The application does not call PBKDF2 itself; anyone using the bundle's PBKDF2 inherits these defaults.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Vendored jsrsasign bundles CryptoJS HMAC-SHA-1 (SHA-1 round function at line 112 of the minified bundle), shipped in 5 resource copies; the served addTansaction.html loads the bundle, so HMAC-SHA-1 is available to any page caller. SHA-1-based MAC is legacy; the app's own signing uses SHA256withRSA instead.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Vendored jsrsasign's RSA signing utilities (PKCS#1 v1.5 / PSS padding helpers around _rsasign_getHexPaddedDigestInfoForString); the app's served HTML page actually drives this API (SHA256withRSA). RSA signatures are Shor-vulnerable; migration ML-DSA-65.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Official reveal.js multiplex plugin (vendored, third-party): /token derives the presentation-sync token by Blowfish-encrypting a secret made of Date.getTime() + Math.random()*9999999 through createCipher('blowfish', secret)'s password-based EVP_BytesToKey(MD5) KDF. The token is predictable (weak PRNG + timestamp) and the KDF is MD5-based — replaceable only by the vendor, observable here. The Math.random input is separately tracked under the non-cryptographic PRNG object.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Vendored jsrsasign's ECParameterDB named-curve registry includes secp256r1 (P-256) at line 239; the bundle is loaded by the served addTansaction.html. P-256 ECDSA/ECDH is Shor-vulnerable (migration ML-DSA-65 / ML-KEM-768); available to any caller of the shipped library.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Vendored jsrsasign's ECParameterDB also registers secp384r1 and secp521r1 (P-384/P-521) at line 239 of the same bundle; Shor-vulnerable NIST curves available to any caller of the loaded library.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Vendored jsrsasign bundles CryptoJS SHA-256/SHA-384/SHA-512 and their HMAC helpers (HmacSHA256/384/512 via _createHmacHelper at lines 122/146/155 of the minified bundle), shipped in 5 resource copies and loaded by the served addTansaction.html. HMAC-SHA-256+ is the strong MAC tier of the shipped library (quantum-affected only via Grover); no application call site uses it — the app signs with SHA256withRSA instead.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: CryptoJS PBKDF2 implementation inside the vendored jsrsasign bundle (lines 195-196), shipped in 5 copies. Its shipped default configuration is keySize 4 (128-bit), SHA-1 hasher, iterations 1 — the weak-configuration aspect is separately rated under ALG-a861135a; this object records the PBKDF2 capability itself being present in the app's resources.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: The application's own hashing: HashUtil.kt computes SHA-256 over block nonce+content+preHash for the toy blockchain's block hash and proof-of-work. SHA-256 is not Shor-vulnerable (Grover only) and is a sound choice; recorded as the chain's hash function. Used by NoteServer.kt validation and TranslateTest.kt signature digest.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Vendored jsrsasign's RNG: a pool-based generator (rng_seed_int/rng_pool) with crypto.getRandomValues seeding where available — the library's random source for key generation and nonces, shipped in 5 resource copies. Availability of the CSPRNG path depends on the browser runtime.
